name: Serv00 Free Shared Web Hosting
free_limit: Provider-operated free shared hosting with 3 GB SSD storage, advertised unlimited transfer, up to 100 websites, 10 MySQL/3 PostgreSQL/3 MongoDB databases, 512 MB RAM and SSH access; free subdomain and no forced ads.
watch_out: Not a free VPS or root server. Terms restrict accounts to website/email/repository hosting; VPN, proxy, tunneling and resale are prohibited. Terms state accounts without a proper panel/SSH login for 90 days may be deleted, and backups are not guaranteed. Resource abuse may trigger suspension; commercial website eligibility and payment verification require checking.
